mind.definition:
n. that which is responsible for one's thoughts and feelings; the seat of the faculty of reason
n. recall or remembrance
n. attention
n. your intention; what you intend to do
mind.translation:
n. 思想, 愿望, 智力, 记忆, 心理, 情绪, 理智, 主意, 心意
vi. 介意, 注意, 留心
vt. 注意, 留意, 专心于, 照看, 介意

mind blindness.translation: [医] 精神性盲, 视觉性失认

mind cure.translation: [医] 精神疗法, 心理疗法

mind expansion.translation: [网络] 思维扩展；思维扩散

mind game.translation: （尤指为了压倒对方而展开的）心理游戏, 心理战术

mind over bladder.definition:
The power to be able to suppress any urination needs regardless of the urgency and pain it may cause.
> Joe: Dude! Stop the car! I REALLY need to take a piss right now!!
> Pete: No can do, man! Just use your mind over bladder!

mind reader.translation: n. 测心术者, 能测人心思者

mind reading.translation: n. 测心术, 心灵感应

mind set.translation: n. 心态；倾向；习惯；精神状态

mind wandering.translation: [医] 冥思, 出神, 心不在焉

mind you.translation: 注意, 留心, 记住

mind's eye.translation: n. 心眼，想象（力）; 心目

mind-.translation:
n. 理智, 精神；意见；智力；记忆力
vt. 介意；专心于；照料
vi. 介意；注意

mind-altering.definition: s producing mood changes or distorted perception
mind-altering.translation: a. （药品）致幻的, 使心情产生变化的

mind-altering drug.translation: [网络] 改变脑力的药；影响下出现

mind-bending.definition: s intensely affecting the mind especially in producing hallucinations
mind-bending.translation: a. <非正>离奇古怪令人费解的

mind-blowing.definition: s. intensely affecting the mind or emotions
mind-blowing.translation: a. 引起幻觉的, 使兴奋的

mind-blowingly.translation: 引起幻觉地; 使人兴奋地

mind-cure.translation: [医] 精神治疗, 心理治疗

mind-expanding.definition: s (of hallucinogenic drugs) giving a sense of heightened or broader awareness

mind-fuck.translation: [网络] 精神强暴；诱；愚蠢的思想

mind-maps.translation: (mind-map 的复数) 思维导图；思维图

mind-numbing.translation: a. （糟糕、无聊或程度强烈到）令人头脑麻木的

mind-readers.translation: (mind-reader 的复数)  洞悉他人心思的人

mind-s.translation:
(mind- 的复数) n. 理智, 精神；意见；智力；记忆力
vt. 介意；专心于；照料
vi. 介意；注意

mind-set.definition: n a habitual or characteristic mental attitude that determines how you will interpret and respond to situations

mind-sets.translation: n. 思想的形式( mind-set的名词复数 )

mindanao.definition: n. the second largest island of the Philippines at the southern end of the archipelago; mountainous and volcanic

mindanao sea.translation: 棉兰老海(在菲律宾的棉兰老岛和米沙鄢群岛之间)

mindblower.translation: n. [俚语]；致幻药, 迷幻药, 幻觉剂, 引起幻觉的毒品

minded.definition: s. (used in combination) mentally oriented toward something specified
minded.translation: a. 有意的, 有心的, 具有意志的

mindel.translation: n. [地]民德(冰期)(欧洲更新世的第二个冰期 )

mindel-riss.translation: n. 【地质学】民德—里斯间冰期

mindelo.translation: [地名] [佛得角、葡萄牙] 明德卢

minden.definition: n. a battle in the Seven Years' War (1759) in which the English forces and their allies defeated the French

minder.definition: n. someone (usually in totalitarian countries) who is assigned to watch over foreign visitors
minder.translation: n. 看守者, 照顾者

minders.definition:
n. someone (usually in totalitarian countries) who is assigned to watch over foreign visitors
n. a person who looks after babies (usually in the person's own home) while the babys' parents are working
minders.translation: n. 看守者, 照顾者( minder的复数形式 )

mindfucker.definition:
One who fucks with your mind.
> People like Charles Manson are mind fuckers.

mindfucking.translation: (mindfuck 的现在分词) n. <俚>高度兴奋状态

mindful.definition: a. bearing in mind; attentive to
mindful.translation: a. 深切注意的, 留神的, 留心的

mindfully.definition: r. in a careful deliberate manner

mindfulness.definition: n. the trait of staying aware of (paying close attention to) your responsibilities

minding.definition:
p. pr. & vb. n. of Mind
n. Regard; mindfulness.
minding.translation: vi. 介意（mind的现在分词形式）

mindless.definition:
s. lacking the thinking capacity characteristic of a conscious being
s. requiring little mental effort
s. not marked by the use of reason
mindless.translation: a. 没头脑的, 不小心的, 不留神的

mindlessly.definition:
r. without intellectual involvement
r. in an unreasonably senseless manner
mindlessly.translation: adv. 不费心思地；愚蠢地

mindlessness.definition:
n total lack of meaning or ideas
n the trait of acting rashly and without prudence
mindlessness.translation: n. 没有思维能力; 愚笨; 无知; 不注意

mindo.translation: [化] 改进的间略微分重叠法

mindon.translation: n. 精神信息粒子,心灵感应粒子(一种假设的传心粒子)

mindoro.definition: n a mountainous island in the central Philippines
mindoro.translation: 民都洛岛[菲律宾中部](在吕宋岛西南)
